scripts.dev: npm run build -w @cbl-log/shared && npm run build -w @cbl-log/engine && npm run dev -w @cbl-log/app
scripts.build: npm run build -w @cbl-log/shared && npm run build -w @cbl-log/engine && npm run build -w @cbl-log/app
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @cbl-log/shared && npm run build -w @cbl-log/engine && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build -w @cbl-log/shared && npm run build -w @cbl-log/engine && npm test --workspaces --if-present
